name: todo-harness
description: Cross-session TODO backlog enforced by hooks. SessionStart injects the project's backlog — id-tagged, grouped, budget-capped, and minus anything locked by another active session — into context; Stop blocks a session that changed files but left the backlog untouched. The backlog is a plain committed Markdown file, so it is shared with the team through git and safe for multiple sessions to work against at once.
